name: cclevel
description: Scores your Claude Code setup and shows it as a creature that grows: level, six stats, mood and what to fix next, with the creature above your prompt while you work (/creature off hides it). Two modes: Default joins the public leaderboard under a generated name (nine numbers, no account); Privacy mode (/pet privacy on) deletes your row and cclevel sends nothing, while the card and creature keep working.
